name: socialcrawl-superengine
description: Deep social research superengine on the SocialCrawl API: the full canon — 645 endpoints across 68 platform namespaces — with exact per-call credits, plus guided research plays — voice-of-customer mining, competitor ad-library recon, AI-visibility (GEO) audits, link-in-bio offer mapping, audience demographics, dev/tool radar — and priced big-gun one-shots (creator vetting, lead discovery, share-of-voice).
